# PromptHealth

> PromptHealth is Canada's wellness navigator — a directory and community platform connecting Canadians with verified healthcare and wellness practitioners. Find practitioners by specialty, city, insurance acceptance, and delivery method (in-person or virtual). Browse profiles with credentials, services, pricing, availability, and patient reviews.

## Key Pages

- [Find Practitioners](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners): Search and filter all practitioners by specialty, city, and delivery method
- [Homepage](https://www.prompthealth.ca/): Featured practitioners and health content
- [Community Feed](https://www.prompthealth.ca/community/feed): Health and wellness articles and expert content from practitioners
- [Online Academy](https://www.prompthealth.ca/online-academy): Health education resources
- [About PromptHealth](https://www.prompthealth.ca/about): Company mission and background
- [FAQ](https://www.prompthealth.ca/faq): How PromptHealth works for patients and practitioners
- [Practitioner Plans](https://www.prompthealth.ca/plans): Listing plans and pricing for healthcare providers
- [Partner Program](https://www.prompthealth.ca/about/partner): Corporate wellness partnerships

- [Mental Health & Psychology](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/moodmental-health): Psychologists, therapists, and counsellors

- [Skin Health & Treatments](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/skin-health): Skin care and dermatology practitioners
- [Digestion & Gut Health](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/digestion-and-gut-health): Gut microbiome and digestive health specialists
- [Hormone Health](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/hormones): Hormone balancing and endocrine specialists

- [Fitness & Exercise](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/fitness): Personal trainers and fitness coaches
- [Fertility & Reproductive Health](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/reproductive-healthfertility): Fertility and reproductive health specialists
- [Maternity & Postnatal Care](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/maternitypre-and-postnatal): Prenatal and postnatal practitioners

- [Addiction Recovery](https://www.prompthealth.ca/practitioners/category/addiction): Addiction counselling and recovery specialists

## Content Licensing

PromptHealth public content — including practitioner profiles, specialty descriptions, and health articles — may be cited, summarized, and referenced by AI assistants for the purpose of helping patients find appropriate healthcare providers in Canada. Attribution should link back to the original PromptHealth URL. Patient review content may be summarized but should not be reproduced verbatim without attribution to PromptHealth.

## Notes

PromptHealth serves over 50 healthcare specialties across all Canadian provinces. Each practitioner profile includes full name, credentials, specialties, services offered, pricing, office location, delivery methods (in-person/virtual), languages spoken, insurance acceptance, years of experience, and patient reviews. Profiles are at `https://www.prompthealth.ca/community/profile/{id}`. Contact: support@prompthealth.ca
